description: Adds a configuration menu to adjust the armor, hull, speed, and flux slowdown thresholds of phase ships. Allows setting the maximum-slowdown hard-flux threshold so high that flux-based slowdown is effectively removed. Includes options to buff or nerf stats and affects ships with phase-like systems.

discordPostHtml:
Adds a lunaconfig menu that allows you to:

  • Nerf the armor, hull, and speed of phase ships (ships with phase-like systems and phase fighters optionally). *
  • Modify the maximum-slowdown hard-flux threshold for all phase ships. The threshold can be set so far above 100% hard flux that it virtually removes all flux-based slowdown.

Save to add/remove mid save; requires lunalib.

https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/htd00nxkadgugwhya8wmu/PhaseShipConfig.zip?rlkey=zmsjdrabocyx90cffofh3wse7&e=1&st=40bbwmcn&dl=0

*or buff those stats, if you change the lunasettings csv
aiDescription: Adds a configuration menu to adjust the armor, hull, speed, and flux slowdown thresholds of phase ships. Allows setting the maximum-slowdown hard-flux threshold so high that flux-based slowdown is effectively removed. Includes options to buff or nerf stats and affects ships with phase-like systems.

changelog.1.0.2: When "Phase Slowdown Threshold Percent" is set to 500 there is now a speed and acceleration bonus (or malus) to phase ships to account for any intended (and now obsolete) change to their threshold from skills or hullmods. (e.g. Adaptive Phase Coils will grant 10% extra speed and 20% extra acceleration while the ship is phasing).
changelog.1.0.1:
Added a setting to configure the maximum-slowdown hard-flux threshold. This can be set so far beyond 100% flux that it effectively disables all slowdown.
 The speed, armor, and hull changes will now affect ships that have phase-like ship systems. Added a toggle to keep excluding the aforementioned ship type.
